LanguageData.TXWC_TankCapacityDesc: The amount of chemfuel the tank holds when full. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_GasPerChemfuelDesc: The number of cells of tox gas each chemfuel makes, whether it is vented, sprayed, or burst from the tank when the pilot goes down. Absorbing gas refills the tank at the same rate. For comparison, a tox pack makes 45 cells from 35 chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_VentRateDesc: The amount of chemfuel released each second while the vents are open. A faster vent makes a wider cloud that clears sooner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_TankSummary: A full tank holds {0} chemfuel, enough for {1} cells of tox gas or about {2} tox packs. Venting empties it in {3} seconds.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetCostDesc: The amount of chemfuel each gas jet draws from the tank. Without a tank, the jets stored in the shoulders reload for the same amount. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetReserveDesc: The number of gas jets the shoulders carry on their own. They are only used when no tank is worn, and reload with chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetConeWidthDesc: The width of the cone the gas jet sprays. A wider cone spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetRangeDesc: The distance the gas jet reaches. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetWarmupDesc: The time the pilot takes to aim the gas jet before it fires. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetSummary: Each jet draws {0} chemfuel and sprays {1} cells of tox gas, about {2} tox packs. A full tank holds {3} jets and the shoulders alone hold {4}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbRadiusDesc: The distance around the pilot that gas is drawn in from. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbDurationDesc: The time the respirator keeps drawing gas in after each use. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbCooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after absorbing gas before absorbing again. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbSummary: Absorbing gas draws from the {0} cells around the pilot. A full cloud over all of them refills {1} chemfuel.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerTierDesc: When enabled, the toxin warcasket is rebuilt as a 10th generation spacer warcasket like the siegebreaker. It gains spacer plating and insulation, a shield bubble, resistance to toxins, psychic effects and vacuum{0}, and loses its speed penalty, but it costs spacer components and plasteel, needs the spacer warcaskets research, and can be worn by veteran raiders. When disabled, it stays a 7th generation set. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Armor: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, fitted with a tox gas tank that vents around the pilot.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Shoulders: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket pauldrons with standard protection, fitted with shoulder-mounted jets that spray tox gas from the shell's tank.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Helmet: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, sealed behind a respirator that keeps out tox gas and draws it back into the shell's tank.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerLoreGeneration: 10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armor designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armors have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armor series even across generations.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerLoreSeries: The Toxin series is built for chemical warfare. A tank in the shell feeds vents around the pilot and gas jets on the pauldrons, and the helmet's respirator draws gas back into the tank. Together the pieces make the pilot immune to toxins.
LanguageData.TXWC_ToxinVacuumDesc: When enabled, the toxin warcasket resists vacuum like a spacer warcasket, with none of the tier's other changes. When disabled, it is as exposed to vacuum as the other 7th generation sets. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_HazardVacuumDesc: When enabled, the hazard warcasket resists vacuum like a spacer warcasket. When disabled, it is left as Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates ships it. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_FeedToxAbsorptionDesc: When enabled, a tank with gas in it counts as tox gas for a pilot with the tox absorption gene from {0}, so their pollution mutations stay active. No gas is used. When disabled, the gene only reacts to gas in the air. Default: on.
